Hello, following up on the open ticket regarding the brown water leak coming from my kitchen ceiling.

Initial response issue: When the leak first appeared, I called the emergency maintenance line and received no answer. I called again the same day regarding a separate issue, and also sent a text — I received no reply over the course of about a week. I wanted to document this lack of response as a brown water leak is the kind of problem the emergency line exists for.

To recap the current status of the leak itself:

The maintenance team inspected it but was unable to identify the source.
The unit above mine was also checked, with no visible sign of the leak's origin there.
The technician and I wanted the drywall opened to locate the source, but was instead directed to caulk over it as a temporary measure.
The caulking was done this past Friday. The technician told me he would return Monday to reinstall the molding. As of today, that has not happened, and the molding is still off.

My concern that caulking is treating the symptom rather than the cause. Brown water hints at a sewage or contaminated water line leak, which is both a health hazard and a risk to the structural integrity of the wall and ceiling. Sealing the visible spot does not stop the water — it simply hides where it's escaping while it continues to accumulate behind the drywall.

I'm requesting the following:

A proper diagnostic inspection that includes opening the drywall to locate and identify the actual source of the leak.
Repair of the underlying plumbing/sewer line, not just cosmetic sealing.
Reinstallation of the molding and any drywall repair once the source is fixed.
An estimated timeline for each of these steps would be appreicated. 

Confirmation of the correct procedure and contact for after-hours emergencies, since the emergency line did not work when I needed it.
I'd appreciate confirmation of the next steps and a scheduled date for the follow-up work. Please let me know if you need access to my unit; I'm happy to arrange a time.

Can you please schedule a visit and take care of this issue?
